customer_change_of_mind.approved_scope: After-delivery change-of-mind returns and exchanges only; separately decide cancellation before shipment.
customer_change_of_mind.policy_ja: お客様都合による返品・交換は、未開封・未使用の場合も含めてお受けしておりません。商品不良・破損・誤配送その他法令上の権利がある場合は、この制限の対象外です。
customer_change_of_mind.exceptions_ja: 商品不良・破損・誤配送その他事業者側の責任や法令に基づく権利については別途対応します。
customer_change_of_mind.decision_needed: No further decision on buyer change-of-mind return eligibility. Order cancellation, defective merchandise, stockouts, refunds and complete statutory disclosure remain pending.

before_shipping_cancel.proposed: Inspect supplier order and shipping state before cancellation decision
before_shipping_cancel.decision_needed: Paid-but-not-ordered, ordered, and dispatched cases; fees/refund

defect_damage_wrong_item.proposed: Request report and offer exchange or refund for confirmed defects/wrong items; seller-funded return freight when seller responsible
defect_damage_wrong_item.decision_needed: Verification, exchange eligibility, return address, response timeline, no impairment of statutory buyer rights

supplier_out_of_stock_or_delay.proposed: Contact customer promptly; arrange restock agreement or cancellation and full refund where fulfillment impossible
supplier_out_of_stock_or_delay.decision_needed: Customer confirmation, communication deadline, late delivery options

refund_and_contact.proposed: Use original Square payment route where feasible; info@bigpaw.site for pre-sale questions
refund_and_contact.decision_needed: Refund period, operative legal contact, operator workflow

notes: Customer change-of-mind return exclusion has proprietor confirmation, but the complete returns/cancellation/refund policy is NOT yet approved or published, the production launch guard remains OFF, and mandatory statutory buyer rights are preserved. Seller identity/contact details were supplied privately and must not be committed to this repository.

customer_change_of_mind_return.applies_to: dog food customer change-of-mind return/exchange, including unopened goods

seller_identity_contact.statutory_publication_method: pending owner choice: publish details or compliant timely disclosure on request
